tool_signatures.name: batch_get_events_v1_events_batch_post
tool_signatures.description:
Fetch multiple events by id in a single round-trip — for agents that
already have a list of ids (e.g. from GET /v1/events) and want full detail
for each without issuing one GET per event.

Body: {"event_ids": [1, 2, 3], "include_odds": bool, "include_intelligence": bool, "bookmaker": str}
Max 25 ids per call. Duplicate ids are billed once. Credits are the sum of
each event's normal GET /v1/events/{id} cost — billing fairness applies
per event (unavailable odds/intelligence are free; ids that don't exist
cost nothing and are returned under "not_found").

tool_signatures.name: get_event_period_odds_v1_events__event_id__period_odds_get
tool_signatures.description: NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAB, MLB, Soccer, and Tennis only. Joins persisted first_half_spreads / first_half_totals mains to this-event period scores (1H = Q1+Q2, NCAAB or soccer native 1H; MLB F5 = innings 1–5; tennis S1 = first-set games) and grades the period, not the full game. GET /odds stays on h2h/spreads/totals. Other sports return HTTP 400. available:false is free.

tool_signatures.name: get_event_player_props_v1_events__event_id__player_props_get
tool_signatures.description: NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAB, NHL, and MLB only. Joins persisted player-prop mains to this-event player box rows and grades over/under/push (1:1 slugs, combo sums, weighted combos, and yes/no thresholds). GET /odds stays on h2h/spreads/totals. Other sports return HTTP 400. available:false is free. Market catalog: https://lumify.ai/docs/player-props

tool_signatures.name: get_event_prediction_markets_v1_events__event_id__prediction_markets_get
tool_signatures.description: NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NHL, MLB, Soccer, and Tennis only. Persist-then-read from Fanatics Markets, Kalshi, and Polymarket. Prices are implied probabilities in (0, 1] — never American odds, never BOOK_SLUGS, never GET /odds. Game-line contracts only (h2h / spreads / totals; soccer 1X2 as three outcomes). Other sports return HTTP 400. available:false is free.

tool_signatures.name: get_event_splits_v1_events__event_id__splits_get
tool_signatures.description: Public bets% and handle% per side (moneyline, spread, total), with a cross-book consensus and per-bookmaker breakdown. Bookmaker keys match /odds slugs (e.g. draftkings, fanduel) under bookmakers[].bookmaker. Available for MLB, NBA, NHL, NFL, NCAAF, and NCAAB. Not available for tennis or soccer (upstream 400). available:false is free.

tool_signatures.name: get_event_stats_v1_events__event_id__stats_get
tool_signatures.description: Soccer, MLB, tennis, NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAB, and NHL. Deterministic aggregates from completed results — no odds (see /odds) and no scoring (see /intelligence). Payload shapes are sport-specific (team-keyed except tennis). Tennis: main-draw singles only (doubles/qualifying return available:false). Form/record/H2H exclude walkovers and NFL/NCAAF/NBA/NCAAB preseason. Other sports return HTTP 400. available:false is free. Field catalog: https://lumify.ai/docs/reference#event-stats

tool_signatures.description: NFL, NCAAF, MLB, and Soccer only. Joins persisted team-total mains to this-event participant scores and grades over/under/push. GET /odds stays on h2h/spreads/totals. Other sports return HTTP 400. available:false is free.

tool_signatures.name: query_events_v1_query_post
tool_signatures.description:
Map a natural-language query to the same filters GET /v1/events accepts,
then run that exact list query — results are identical to, and as fresh
as, calling /v1/events directly. This is a small rule-based mapper, not an
LLM call — see the module-level `_parse_nl_query` docstring for exactly
what it recognizes.

Body: {"query": "live nfl games today", "limit": 25}
An explicit top-level "limit" overrides one parsed from the text. Costs 1
credit, same as GET /v1/events — interpreting the query text is free.
